हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/e9F8z4
show.description: "Jhootha Parivaar" is a high-stakes family revenge drama that follows Ishaan, an outcast son who is granted a supernatural second chance to relive his past after a tragic death caused by his family's neglect. Armed with foreknowledge of their betrayals and the manipulation of his "perfect" adopted brother, Rudra, Ishaan transforms from a silent victim into a strategic powerhouse. The script blends intense emotional confrontation with a "rise-from-the-ashes" narrative as Ishaan dismantles his family's toxic legacy to build his own empire
